descriptions.notStarted: Code red~! There's a hole in the ship and The Nautilus is in danger!  The Nautilus' crew, Bonnie, is trying everything to stop the hole all by herself... We can't let The Nautilus sink like this! I must go and help!
descriptions.inProgress: The hole on the ship must be stopped with a solid horn. I should go and find #b50 solid horns#k before Bonnie loses all her strength.  \n\n#i4000073##t4000073#  #b#c4000073#/50#k
descriptions.completed: Whew, I can't believe we saved The Nautilus from sinking into the ocean. Bonnie and I saved The Nautilus!
